rule: Before telling the owner something is possible, check this list. If it is not listed as available, say Piezas doesn't support it yet (contract Rule 11). Never build it yourself inside Piezas, never call Piezas addresses that are not in the contract, and never edit or rebuild @piezas/sdk.

available.what: Sign up, sign in, sign out and password reset with email and password
Confirm a member's email address with an emailed link
Second step with an authenticator app (TOTP)
Second step with an emailed code
Sign in with Google, through @piezas/sdk/sso (the owner sets the Google client id and secret as hosting environment variables)
Sign in with Microsoft (Entra), through @piezas/sdk/sso (the owner sets the Microsoft client id and secret as hosting environment variables)

integrations.note: Integrations read and write a provider's data for the app. They never sign people in.

available.what: Google Calendar: calendars, free/busy, events
Google Drive: list, read and create files, share them
Gmail: send and list messages, list labels
Zoom: create, read, update and delete meetings
HubSpot: contacts, companies and deals
DocuSign: send envelopes and read their status
QuickBooks: customers, invoices, bills, journal entries
AWS Textract: read receipts, invoices and documents
Free plan: up to 2 apps, 50 MB each, at <app>.apps.piezas.ai
Settings and secrets are set by the owner on the app page (Hosting → Environment) or with `piezas env set` in their own terminal. Values are write-only: never read back, never through the chat.
Business records (entities): create, list, search, update, links, activity, CSV/JSON export
Pipelines and boards (stages an item moves through)
Tasks
Calendars, availability, open slots and bookings
Forms
Store and serve documents
Signature requests
Read data out of documents (extraction jobs)
Background jobs: enqueue, claim, requeue
One message to one person for something they did or need: confirmations, resets, alerts, reminders
The Report a problem button and the owner's report list
Dashboards and reports
Quotes and price documents
Comment threads
Searchable help articles
